examples.explanation: Inserting 0 twice records true then false; removing the absent 1 records false.
With only 5 in the set, getRandom must return 5; removing 5 then succeeds.

hints: Pair a value-to-index map with a dense list of values.
Insert appends at the end; removal swaps the target with the last entry and pops.
getRandom picks a uniform index; the judge accepts any current member.
title: 456. Insert Delete GetRandom O(1)
